lookback_notes: NOT_FOUND — the Invalid Service Documentation section (p. 4) states no observation/look-back window. It ties validity to the date of service (on-site presence of identified personnel on the date of service) but does not state a lookback period in days. The document's overall applicability is stated as service dates 01/01/2013 through 10/31/2025, which is a service-date scope, not an assessor lookback window.

federal_coding_rules.rule: The claim will be disallowed if the service documentation cannot establish the identity of the personnel who provided care.

source.quote: If the service documentation cannot establish the identity of the personnel who provided care, or the on-site presence of the identified personnel is unsupported on the date of service, or the documentation is otherwise determined as invalid, the claim will be disallowed.

state_deltas.delta: This is a New York State (OMIG) audit protocol; the Invalid Service Documentation criterion and its regulatory references (10 NYCRR § 763.13(i); 18 NYCRR §§ 487.10(d)(5)(vii), 488.10(d)(4)(vii), 494.3(b), 494.5; ALP Manual Policy Guidelines Version 2006-1, Section II) are New York-specific requirements applied to ALP claims.
Time-banded regulatory authority: for services 05/25/18 and after, 18 NYCRR § 494.4(c) applies; for services 03/17/93 through 05/24/18, 18 NYCRR § 494.4(b) applies.
